title: Density of Current–Current Correlation Measures
exact_target: Determine whether the current--current energy correlation measure of the random Schrödinger model is absolutely continuous.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000709 (OWR-1463-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Transport in Multi-Dimensional Random Schrödinger Operators (2007), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2007/12, pp. 667--708; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 18--19, printed pages 684--685.
localization-regime density theorem; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: The trace-per-unit-volume and spectral-product convention of the report is essential to the measure definition. The source proves analytic densities off a disorder-dependent neighborhood of the energy diagonal for a particular analytic single-site distribution; the question includes the diagonal and broader source setting.
